generalizability.description: Skill is reusable by multiple CLIs/services, not specific to one tool

schemaCompleteness.description: Valid JSON schema with all required fields documented

testCoverage.description: Unit tests covering happy path and error cases (80%+ coverage)

documentation.description: README or inline docs with purpose, inputs, outputs, examples

productionReadiness.description: Error handling, logging, no code smells (console.log, hardcoded values)

nonCLISpecific.description: No TTY, process.exit, file watching, or CLI-specific libraries
